build_llama_generator: build a Llama generator from a checkpoint directory and tokenizer path for inference
run_chat_completion: run batched chat completions on a list of user and system prompt instructions
run_instruction_batch: run a batch of multi-turn instructions through the Llama model with temperature and top_p sampling
generate_with_system_prompt: generate model responses using a system prompt to constrain output language like JavaScript
run_llama_cli: run the Llama chat completion example via fire CLI with configurable temperature and sequence length
